split.type: 80/20 stratified by NSP; within-class test size rounded; shuffled training classes dealt round-robin to three sites

protocol.bounds_policy: Same campaign rule: public TRAIN cohort min/max widened by 10 percent of each range, plus/minus 0.5 for constants. Declared before training, never derived from test. This public-data utility simulation does not claim that private empirical extrema can be freely disclosed.

training.parameters: All pytorch_multiclass v0.5.0 registry defaults: linear softmax, 3 classes, SGD, learning_rate 0.1, batch_size 32, local_epochs 1, no scheduler, no regularization
training.privacy: Unchanged node defaults except administrator per-training epsilon; delta 1e-6, row unit, clipping norm 1, replace-one adjacency
training.inner_validation: None; no schedule selection or hyperparameter search

protocol.central: nnet::multinom, decay=0, maxit=3000, reltol=1e-10, MaxNWts=10000. Same clipped affine bounds transform as federated model; fit pooled training data; require convergence=0.
protocol.trivial: Training majority class for accuracy; training class proportions for probability metrics, yielding tied-score macro-AUC 0.5. No test prevalence used.
protocol.metrics: Unweighted mean of three one-vs-rest rank AUCs with average ties; argmax accuracy; natural-log multiclass log-loss with true-class probability floor 1e-15. Gap is federated minus central macro-AUC. SD is sample SD over three paired seeds.
protocol.diagnostic: At epsilon 8, mean accuracy strictly above mean majority accuracy AND mean macro-AUC > 0.5. Also disclose each replicate and whether all pass.
protocol.test_use: One scoring pass per replicate, after settings are fixed; no rerun of a scored cell with changed settings.
protocol.alternative: None: full specified cohort is used and no fallback multiclass contract is named. Report a failing diagnostic as a boundary.

datasets.validation: All three cells: paired splits/bounds/baselines; 3 sites, 5 rounds, zero failures; node policies and runner hashes; means and sample SD independently recomputed.

split.type: Official subject-disjoint train/test split; 21 training subjects, 9 held-out subjects. For each seed, shuffle sorted training subjects with R sample and assign consecutive groups of seven to three sites.
split.seed_scope: Subject-to-site partition and central initialization only. Generic federated Torch initialization and node cryptographic DP randomness retain release behavior; published seeds do not fully reproduce federated fits.

protocol.bounds_policy: Declared public bounds [-1,1] for every feature, from official archive README. Clip and affine-scale identically in central and released federated preprocessing. No data-derived bounds.
protocol.released_patient_semantics: Unchanged dsFlower 0.5.0 generic patient path clips/transforms each window to public bounds, averages features within subject, selects the modal class (smallest class breaks ties), then applies DP-SGD clipping to each pooled subject. Thus 7 effective training units/site and 21 overall, not gradients of all window losses grouped by subject. Central reference is trained on all official training windows; it shares split/model family/bounds but not this pooling.

training.parameters: All pytorch_multiclass v0.5.0 optimization defaults: linear softmax, SGD, learning_rate 0.1, batch_size 32, local_epochs 1, no scheduler, no regularization. Sole schema override n_classes=6 for six public activities.
training.privacy: patient unit with subject column, clipping norm 1, replace-one adjacency; per-node per-training epsilon 1/4/8, delta 1e-6. Seven pooled subjects and batch size32 imply full-unit sampling and one update/round.
training.inner_validation: None; no optimization search, validation split or post-score changes.

protocol.central: Unregularized multinomial logistic regression (nnet::multinom decay=0, maxit=3000, reltol=1e-10, MaxNWts=10000), fit all 7352 official training windows with public bounded transform; require convergence=0. Fit once per seed and reuse across epsilon. This is a window-trained central reference, not a subject-pooling-matched preprocessing twin.
protocol.trivial: Training-window majority class for accuracy; training-window class proportions for probabilities. No test prevalence used.
protocol.metrics: Window-level unweighted mean of six one-vs-rest rank AUCs with average ties; argmax accuracy with first-class tie break; natural-log multiclass log-loss with true-class probability floor1e-15. Gap is federated-DP minus central macro-AUC, sample SD across three replicate seeds on one fixed official split.
protocol.diagnostic: At epsilon8, mean accuracy strictly above training-majority predictor test accuracy AND mean macro-AUC >0.5. Disclose every replicate and whether all pass. No alternative after this one.
protocol.test_use: Train all three central and nine federated models without opening test members; training callback never forces its test promise. Create scoring marker, open official X_test/y_test/subject_test once in one final scoring run, then score each fitted model once. Never rerun a scored cell with changed settings.
protocol.failure_policy: Retain started run markers and any failure; no overwrite. Report whatever diagnostic outcome occurs.

dataset.size_choice: cdc45k fixed at 45000 rows; 20 inputs and linear softmax on provisioned 32-vCPU pod. No timing pilot or scored fallback.

split.type: 80/20 split stratified by GenHlth using rounded per-class test counts, followed by shuffled per-class round-robin dealing into three sites; copied campaign_split algorithm.
split.seed_scope: Cohort partitioning and central initialization; federated initialization and cryptographic sticky node DP randomness retain release behavior.

protocol.bounds_policy: Fixed public schema, copied from the CDC trees campaign declaration: binary [0,1], BMI [0,100] (declared clipping domain, not empirical extrema), MentHlth/PhysHlth [0,30], Age [1,13], Education [1,6], Income [1,8]. Clip and affine-scale to [-1,1] identically for central and federation; no empirical test or train bounds.

training.parameters: All v0.5.0 registry optimization defaults: linear softmax, SGD, learning_rate 0.1, batch_size 32, local_epochs 1, momentum 0, nesterov false, weight_decay 0, l1_penalty 0, scheduler none, hidden_layers []; only n_classes=5 supplies the public output schema.
training.privacy: Row unit, clipping norm 1, replace-one adjacency, epsilon per node training. Nine fits do not constitute a single composed privacy guarantee.
training.inner_validation: None; no tuning or model selection.

protocol.central: Unregularized multinomial logistic regression nnet::multinom(decay=0,maxit=3000,reltol=1e-10,MaxNWts=10000), identical training rows and public bounded transform. Require convergence=0; fit once per split seed and reuse scores across epsilon.
protocol.trivial: Training class proportions for probabilities; their majority for hard prediction. No test prevalence used.
protocol.metrics: Mean of five one-vs-rest rank AUCs with average ties, argmax accuracy with first-class tie break, natural-log log-loss with true-class probability floor 1e-15. Paired gap = federated-DP macro-AUC minus central; mean and sample SD over three replicates.
protocol.diagnostics: Annotations only, not acceptance or pass/fail: epsilon-8 mean macro-AUC > 0.5 and accuracy strictly above majority predictor test accuracy; disclose replicate indicators too. Report any outcome; no further alternative.
protocol.test_use: Preparation reads raw data only to reproduce the fixed cohort and stratified partitions, writes sealed held-out RDS and separate training RDS without examining or reporting test values/statistics. Training opens only training RDS. After all three central and nine federated models finish, create scoring marker and open sealed held-out RDS once in one final scoring phase. Score each fitted model once; reuse central scores across epsilon. Never rerun a scored cell or change settings after scoring.
protocol.failure_policy: Refuse existing run directories, score markers and cell artifacts; preserve failures and artifacts. Release code and the shared/logistic/CTG/HAR tooling remain unchanged.

preparation.test_policy: Prepared and sealed; no held-out values or statistics examined or reported.

interpretations.ctg: Ranking retained, argmax calibration lost under class imbalance at 1701 training rows. The original CTG measurements are retained unchanged.
interpretations.har561: Subject-level privacy with seven units per site is outside the useful regime at every budget in the grid; this is a utility-law boundary, not a defect. The original HAR561 measurements are retained unchanged.
interpretations.cdcgenhlth: Pre-declared cdc45k alternative: 45000 survey respondents, one row per respondent, five nominal GenHlth classes. At epsilon 8, mean macro-AUC is 0.751227 versus central 0.783736; mean accuracy is 0.434074 versus majority 0.350000. Diagnostics are annotations only. This scored outcome is final; no further alternative.

interpretation: CTG and HAR561 remain documented boundary measurements. CDC GenHlth is the pre-declared large-cohort row-private alternative. All outcomes are retained; epsilon-8 diagnostics are descriptive annotations, not acceptance criteria.
